governance.decisionForum: King’s Edge Portfolio Board, with referral to relevant Digital and IT product, architecture, data, assurance and service governance where formal authority is required.
governance.decisionScope: Material decisions about the Student Experience Hub product direction, target experience and priority journeys, shared app and platform architecture, journey and service ownership, sequencing, platform investment and operating costs, integration and data dependencies, rationalisation of existing entry points, and enduring product and service ownership.
governance.businessAsUsualOwner: TBC – enduring Student Experience Hub product and service owner
governance.businessAsUsualOwnershipNote: The enduring ownership model should be agreed during year one, before the wider student app begins to scale beyond King’s Edge. It should distinguish accountable Hub product and platform ownership under 4.1.2 from the multidisciplinary team and product practices established through 4.1.3, and establish how cross-service student journeys are owned and governed where no single service controls the whole experience.
